اعتزلتما (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَلْتُمَا (iʕtazaltumā) /iʕ.ta.zal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اُعْتُزِلْتُمَا (uʕtuziltumā) /uʕ.tu.zil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
